description: A constant function is represented by the corresponding constant term in the language with allowed parameters.
signature:
Set.TermDefinable₁.const.{u, v, w} {M : Type w} {A : Set M} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [L.Structure M]
  (C : (L.withConstants ↑A).Constants) : Set.TermDefinable₁ L (Function.const M ↑C)
